title: Ownership guard
rules: Do not edit product files until ownership is valid.
Use only packet-returned claim or heartbeat actions.

sections.heading: Resolution
sections.body: Call cadre_workflow with the target track. If it returns an ownership conflict, review the owner and lease evidence.

sections.heading: Mutation
sections.body: Use returned `mutate.claim` or `mutate.heartbeat` actions. Takeover requires explicit packet support and user authorization.
